 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect spelling is 'Peculair'.
 
• The correct spelling should be** 'Peculiar'.**
 
• The word **"Peculiar"** means strange or odd; unusual. (अजीब)
 
 
• **Example:** She had a peculiar habit of collecting old newspapers.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Parallel** (समानांतर): Extending in the same direction and at the same distance apart.

 
 
• **Example:** The two roads are parallel to each other.
 
 
 
• **Mediterranean** (भूमध्यसागरीय): Refers to the region or the sea surrounded by Southern Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East.
 
 
• **Example:** They planned a vacation to the Mediterranean coast.
 
 
 
• **Miscellaneous** (विविध): Consisting of various kinds or types.
 
 
• **Example:** The drawer was filled with miscellaneous items.
